notInSource.says: operational in all States/UTs except West Bengal

notes: ERSS-112 is established in all 36 States and UTs, with computer-aided dispatch of field/police resources. Source: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleseDetailm.aspx?PRID=2203027&reg=3&lang=2 (PIB, 12 Dec 2025), retrieved 2026-09-26.

ERSS-112 is run State by State: each State/UT's Public Safety Answering Point receives calls, SMS and other channels and dispatches Police / Health / Fire / Disaster / Women / Children / Railways services. Source: https://www.mha.gov.in/en/commoncontent/emergency-response-support-system-erss, retrieved 2026-09-26.

ERSS uses a location-based service/global positioning service to identify the location of a distressed caller. Source: https://www.mha.gov.in/MHA1/Par2017/pdfs/par2025-pdfs/LS11032025/1954.pdf (MHA, Lok Sabha Unstarred Q. 1954, 11 Mar 2025), retrieved 2026-09-26.
Women Helpline 181 is operational in all States/UTs except West Bengal. Source: https://wcd.gov.in/offerings/women--helpline--scheme, retrieved 2026-09-26.

Women Helpline 181 is integrated with ERSS-112 and connects callers to police, fire and ambulance services and One Stop Centres. Source: https://wcd.gov.in/offerings/women--helpline--scheme, retrieved 2026-09-26.
